content: in a court case the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property the defendant was awarded the movable property a car and the immovable property an apartment the defendant was also ordered to pay the applicant a compensation of eur 15000 and to pay off personal debts to two creditors the legal text discusses various articles from the civil code related to matrimonial property the applicant filed an amended application to dissolve the marriage and requested the division of assets compensation recognition of debts and retention of their surname the court granted the applicants claims and ordered the defendant to pay the applicant eur 15000 the court also recognized the debts as the defendants personal debts and ordered the defendant to pay the applicants costs the marriage will be dissolved through the civil registry office the applicant will keep their married name while the defendant will revert to their natural name the matrimonial property will be divided and the defendant will receive the apartment car and personal property the applicant is ordered to pay the defendant eur 15000 and the costs of the proceedings the state is responsible for paying the defendants costs for serving procedural documents
